desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed Verity Backroom Escape!

How to play: 
🚶 Each step = +1 speed
🗺️ Cross Stages and obstacles
🤝Get Wins to Unlock powerful multipliers! 
💥 Do rebirth to Get Speed Multipliers and Rest the Progress 
🎢 Purchase Trails
🤝Invite Friends to Get a Speed Boost
☺️Get Badges for completing game

❤️ Smash that like button! 
🔔 Follow the game for fresh updates & secret rewards!
